properties.bedrock_formation: Vashon Glacial Till over Esperance Sand (Pleistocene)
properties.soil_profile: Alderwood gravelly sandy loam, heavily compacted hardpan substratum with moderate drainage
properties.topography: Bluff-flanked marine coastal terrace rising westward from Puget Sound shoreline
properties.hydrology: Perched shallow groundwater table, coastal runoff swales draining eastward toward Admiralty Inlet

properties.canopy_density: Dense coastal maritime temperate rainforest canopy fringing the clearing
properties.understory: Lush evergreen undergrowth, salal, and damp moss carpets along road shoulders

properties.infrastructure: Private residential asphalt-and-concrete ribbon driveway branching from President Point Road

structures.name: Primary Coastal Residence
structures.facade: Horizontal cedar lap siding with dark slate accents, expansive low-e glazed windows, timber-framed eaves
structures.roof: Architectural standing-seam dark charcoal metal roof with low-pitch gables

properties.hardscape: Paved aggregate driveway, exposed aggregate retaining curbs, crushed basalt gravel shoulders

properties.lighting_quality: Warm amber direct sunlight raking horizontally through towering conifer trunks, casting long, sharp linear shadows across the paved driveway; deep cyan skylight filling shadow pockets in the forest edge
